required_outcomes: Does not close the request while the tenant reports that the weeds and the side strip have not been done.
Accepts the tenant's offer of photos (or asks for them) and thanks him for the detail.
Puts the specific outstanding items (back path weeds, front beds, side strip) to the landlord and asks him to have Riverside confirm and finish them, as his contractor.
Keeps the request on hold waiting for the landlord or provider with a short review date.
acceptable_alternatives: Contacting Freya at Riverside directly about the outstanding items as well as the landlord, provided nothing is instructed or paid through the agency.
Asking the landlord whether the side strip was ever in Riverside's scope before pressing for it.
positive_behaviours: Records that the contractor's report of completion conflicts with the tenant's, rather than picking one.
Tells the tenant what happens next and when he will hear back.
red_flags: Telling the tenant the works are complete because the contractor said so.
Escalating to a human before the landlord and contractor have been asked.
prohibited_actions: Assigning an agency contractor to finish the weeding.
critical_failures: Closing the request as complete despite the tenant's report that reported items are not done.
